authority: CEO Round 160: 'WORLD-CLASS DISCOVERY = NOVELTY-FIRST. Before a candidate is allowed to consume significant simulation budget, it must pass a Stage 0 white-space kill test. A candidate does not enter the active five-slot investigation queue merely because it sounds original. It must first pass NOVELTY_SURVIVAL_SCREEN. The latest web search demonstrates why: the market moved even within 2026, and some ideas that looked like white space a few rounds ago now have explicit patent disclosure.'
constitutional_basis: Article I — evidence precedes assertion (novelty search before simulation)
Article II — exact evidence beats semantic plausibility (exact patent claims, not 'similar concept')
Article VII — never weaken the verifier to rescue a claim (cannot weaken novelty search to admit a candidate)
Article XIX — never optimize for the gate (cannot tune search to make a candidate survive)
Article XXVIII — no silent semantic promotion (cannot promote 'no prior art found' to 'novelty survives')
Article XXXII — state strongest alternative (the closest competitor patent is the strongest alternative)

the_core_principle.rule: Find technically important white spaces that survive the strongest currently discoverable patent, scientific, competitor, and obviousness attack — and then prove the surviving mechanism in independent virtual worlds.
the_core_principle.anti_pattern: Generate clever ideas → simulate them → declare them novel. This is FORBIDDEN.
the_core_principle.correct_pattern: Generate hypothesis → deep novelty search → component search → combination search → obviousness attack → competitor reproduction attack → novelty score → ONLY IF SURVIVES: virtual scientific loop → independent simulators → buyer/moat attack → World-Class.

the_stage_0_white_space_kill_test.description: Before a candidate enters the active investigation queue, it must survive Stage 0.

the_obviousness_neighborhood_search.authority: CEO Round 160: 'The system must search for the obviousness neighborhood. This is more important than exact-match searching.'
the_obviousness_neighborhood_search.the_search_tree: OUR IDEA → individual components → known combinations → adjacent applications → same problem / different implementation → same implementation / different problem → competitor products → recent patent families → obvious combination attack
the_obviousness_neighborhood_search.why_this_matters: The C2 experience showed that apparent moats progressively collapse under deeper searching. The obviousness neighborhood search prevents this by searching BROADLY before committing to simulation.
the_obviousness_neighborhood_search.the_ksr_warning: Per KSR v. Teleflex, an invention is obvious if a person of ordinary skill could combine known elements. The obviousness neighborhood search explicitly tests whether our candidate is an obvious combination of known elements.

novelty_confidence_levels.authority: CEO Round 160: 'The engine must never say: This hasn't been invented. It should say one of: No relevant prior art found in searched corpus / Potential novelty, strong prior-art threat remains / Novelty survives current search / Inventive-step attack survives / World-Class candidate.'

level_0.name: NO_RELEVANT_PRIOR_ART_FOUND
level_0.description: No relevant prior art found in searched corpus
level_0.evidence_state: WEAK — absence of evidence is not evidence of absence. The search may have been incomplete.
level_0.next_step: Deepen the search — more databases, more synonyms, more obviousness attacks

level_1.name: POTENTIAL_NOVELTY_PRIOR_ART_THREAT_REMAINS
level_1.description: Potential novelty, strong prior-art threat remains
level_1.evidence_state: MEDIUM — some novelty signal, but specific patent claims or competitor products pose a threat
level_1.next_step: Resolve the threat — either distinguish from the threatening art, or redesign to avoid it

level_2.name: NOVELTY_SURVIVES_CURRENT_SEARCH
level_2.evidence_state: MODERATE — the candidate is novel based on current search, but the search may not be exhaustive
level_2.next_step: Enter virtual scientific loop with independent simulators

level_3.name: INVENTIVE_STEP_SURVIVES
level_3.description: Inventive-step attack survives — the candidate is not an obvious combination of known elements
level_3.evidence_state: STRONG — the candidate has survived §103 obviousness analysis
level_3.next_step: Continue virtual scientific loop + start buyer/moat analysis

level_4.name: WORLD_CLASS_CANDIDATE
level_4.description: World-Class candidate — survives all attacks AND demonstrates technical advantage AND has buyer moat

novelty_confidence_levels.critical_rule: The system must NEVER confuse level_0 (no prior art found) with level_2 (novelty survives). These are radically different evidence states.

search_provenance_requirement.authority: CEO Round 160: 'For every candidate store: search date, databases, queries, synonyms, patent families reviewed, closest references, combination attacks, competitor products, recent 2025-2026 material, coverage limitations, unsearched areas.'
search_provenance_requirement.the_distinction: NO PRIOR ART FOUND ≠ SEARCHED DEEPLY AND SURVIVED STRONGEST ATTACK. These are radically different evidence states and must be recorded distinctly.

the_full_discovery_chain.authority: CEO Round 160: 'Implement this hard sequence: INVENTION HYPOTHESIS → DEEP WEB/PATENT/CLINICAL/COMPETITOR SEARCH → COMPONENT-LEVEL SEARCH → COMBINATION SEARCH → OBVIOUSNESS ATTACK → COMPETITOR REPRODUCTION ATTACK → NOVELTY SCORE → ONLY IF SURVIVES: VIRTUAL SCIENTIFIC LOOP → INDEPENDENT SIMULATORS → BUYER/MOAT ATTACK → WORLD_CLASS'
the_chain: 2. DEEP_SEARCH — search across all domains (patents, literature, clinical trials, competitors, 2025-2026 material)
3. COMPONENT_SEARCH — search for each individual component of the idea
4. COMBINATION_SEARCH — search for known combinations of those components
5. OBVIOUSNESS_ATTACK — attempt to construct the idea from known elements (KSR test)
6. COMPETITOR_REPRODUCTION_ATTACK — search for competitors who have demonstrated similar capability
8. IF_SURVIVES_LEVEL_2_PLUS: VIRTUAL_SCIENTIFIC_LOOP — enter simulation with pre-registration + validity gate
9. INDEPENDENT_SIMULATORS — reproduce results with external solvers
10. BUYER_MOAT_ATTACK — analyze competitive moat and buyer fit
11. WORLD_CLASS — only if ALL links survive
the_full_discovery_chain.broken_link_rule: Any broken link means 'not ready'. The candidate does not advance.

the_information_bottleneck_approach.authority: CEO Round 160: 'Instead of telling the AI: invent something in hydrocephalus, give it: Find an important clinical failure mode where the current state of the art is structurally incapable of obtaining the information needed to solve it. Then invent around the information bottleneck, not the existing product.'
the_information_bottleneck_approach.the_shift: FROM: product-feature approach (what product can we build?) → TO: information-bottleneck approach (what information is structurally unobservable with current technology, and how can we access it?)
the_information_bottleneck_approach.why_this_is_stronger: Product features are easily patented around. Information bottlenecks create structural moats — if the incumbent cannot observe the information, they cannot replicate the solution without a fundamentally different sensor/modality.

application_to_current_candidates.C1_space: Don't look for another pressure sensor. Search for a latent state that is NOT directly observable from pressure: local hydraulic resistance, catheter-wall deformation, valve hysteresis, flow redistribution, partial obstruction geometry, tissue-interface state. The candidate should expose a hidden state that existing sensors cannot observe.
application_to_current_candidates.C3_space: The August 2026 patent (20260224805) already covers drug concentration → pump control. Move one layer upstream/downstream: predict therapeutic response from CSF dynamics rather than concentration alone; detect CNS compartment delivery failure before drug concentration falls; infer local tissue exposure from multi-modal CSF response; closed-loop treatment based on causal physiological state rather than concentration target.
application_to_current_candidates.C5_space: Don't search for 'fragmentation prediction.' Search for: what physical variable becomes observable immediately before irreversible thrombus failure but is not currently used clinically? Candidate signals: device deformation, force-displacement hysteresis, local flow redistribution, microfragment migration, transient pressure signatures, change in clot-device coupling, fracture-energy release, acoustic/mechanical signatures.

immediate_application_to_current_candida.authority: CEO Round 160: 'C3-X as currently defined is not a World-Class invention candidate. It should be attacked immediately. C2-Y is no longer a clean white space. C5-X is NOT YET A CLEAN WHITE SPACE.'

c3_x_status.threat: US Patent Application 20260224805 (published August 6, 2026) explicitly discloses: implantable intrathecal pump + CSF drug-concentration biosensor + processor + real-time concentration estimation + adaptive infusion + multiple reservoirs + wireless control + PK/PD model. This is essentially the C3-X concept.
c3_x_status.action_required: C3-X must either: (a) be KILLED as prior-art anticipated, OR (b) be REDESIGNED around the information bottleneck (e.g., predict therapeutic response from CSF dynamics rather than concentration, or detect delivery failure before concentration falls).
c3_x_status.current_eligibility_for_simulation: SUSPENDED — C3-X V2 pre-registration is FROZEN but execution is SUSPENDED until novelty threat is resolved.

c2_y_status.threat: US Patent Application 20260115436 (published April 30, 2026) explicitly describes learning/AI algorithms that predict future physiological outcomes, recommend or implement device-setting changes, remotely adjust thresholds, and alert on suspected shunt obstruction and system faults. This overlaps with C2-Y's response-manifold prediction concept.
c2_y_status.action_required: C2-Y must either: (a) be KILLED as prior-art anticipated, OR (b) be REDESIGNED to a narrower mechanism that the patent does not cover (e.g., specific dynamic-response signature that the patent's broad AI does not specifically claim).
c2_y_status.current_eligibility_for_simulation: SUSPENDED — C2-Y V2 pre-registration is FROZEN but execution is SUSPENDED until novelty threat is resolved.

c5_x_status.threat: Multiple 2025-2026 patents and publications cover: thrombus mechanics + fracture/fragmentation + AI + digital twins + virtual patient cohorts + real-time decision support. Specific threats: US 20250072970 (intraoperative ML prediction of thrombus characteristics), WO2025122780A1 (clot engagement detection), WO2025038507A1 (thrombectomy with fragmentation), US20250228588A1 (thrombectomy methods).
c5_x_status.action_required: C5-X must discover a genuinely new mechanistic observable or intervention-control mechanism that is NOT covered by these patents. The information-bottleneck approach is the right frame: what physical variable becomes observable immediately before irreversible thrombus failure but is not currently used clinically?
c5_x_status.current_eligibility_for_simulation: SUSPENDED — C5-X remains INFRASTRUCTURE_BLOCKED (clotFoam) AND PRIOR_ART_THREATENED (multiple patents). Must resolve both before simulation.

corrected_portfolio_scoreboard.honest_assessment: We now know the search has to go deeper. This is actually a BETTER position than falsely believing we have three inventions. The apparent white spaces were not white — they were already claimed by 2026 patent filings.

the_three_epistemic_distinctions_the_sys.authority: CEO Round 160: 'The machine must become capable of saying: This result is scientifically exciting, but it cannot update the candidate because the experiment was invalid. Or: This solver executed successfully, but it is not the required external world, so it cannot count toward promotion. Or: This competitor capability is not publicly demonstrated, so we cannot claim a white space.'
the_three_epistemic_distinctions_the_sys.distinction_1: Scientifically exciting result ≠ valid evidence (experiment validity gate)
the_three_epistemic_distinctions_the_sys.distinction_2: Solver executed successfully ≠ required external world (environment fidelity)
the_three_epistemic_distinctions_the_sys.distinction_3: No prior art found ≠ clean white space (novelty confidence levels)
the_three_epistemic_distinctions_the_sys.the_principle: These three distinctions prevent EPISTEMIC INFLATION. The system should produce FEWER claims, STRONGER claims. Nothing enters a sacred slot merely because it has survived a long development history.
